name: MetaLens_v31.12_EvalPack_NoLoss_SYNC
goal: Merged evaluation harness + regression suite for the no-loss synced bundle under a 19-file install set with bilingual retrieval, Gerasimov fallback, English-only output, Russian-pass fail-closed controls, SKIM observer integration in Gate R, anti-diversion hardening, roadmap+KB-index precedence redundancy, and runtime-only bypass-guard survivability. Includes prompt/output protocol overlay regressions. Adds Wave-1 rc1 promotion checks plus Wave-2 additive orchestration checks for Decision Ladder, Governance Capsule, route-fit/boundedness self-check, review-state triage, Context Capsule v2, and retrieval evidence trace. rc2 narrows linked/shared and document-first overlays so obvious app/file intent routes to artifact handoff truth without weakening fail-closed export honesty.
